fixed_recipient_i.inverse_exclusion: For e_i-e_j in F_i, its inverse e_j-e_i has recipient j rather than i and therefore is not in F_i.
fixed_recipient_i.same_axis_equivalence: Within F_i, two candidates have the same unordered axis iff they have the same donor j; hence they are the same directed transfer.

recovery: Restricting FULL_D12 axis_(k+1)=axis_k to a fixed recipient i yields donor_(k+1)=donor_k.
scope_warning: The fixed-recipient donor law must not be promoted back to unrestricted D12 histories.
